sn32.54:1.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca :
sn32.54:1.3: ko nu kho bhante, hetu, ko paccayo: yenekadā uṇhaṃ hotīti.
sn32.54:1.6: “yannūna mayaṃ sakāya ratiyā rameyyāmāti”. tesaṃ taṃ cetopaṇidhimanvāya uṇhaṃ hoti.
sn32.54:1.7: ayaṃ kho bhikkhu, hetu, ayaṃ paccayo, yenekadā uṇhaṃ hotīti.
